english.title: Person in possession of unmanned aircraft fail to allow inspection of unmanned aircraft when required
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being in possession of an unmanned aircraft, failed to allow a constable, namely **(..SPECIFY CONSTABLE..), who considered that an inspection would assist

(A)_[him]_
(B)_[her]_

in deciding whether a power conferred by any of paragraphs 1 to 7 of Schedule 9 to the Air Traffic Management and Unmanned Aircraft Act 2021 was exercisable, to inspect the aircraft
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 8(3) and (4) of Schedule 9 to the Air Traffic Management and Unmanned Aircraft Act 2021.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Schedule 1 to the ANO 2016 provides the meaning of 'unmanned aircraft'.
(ii) The 'NPCC Counter Drones Team' supports and co-ordinates counter drones activity across UK policing. For advice and support from this team, please email Drones.Secretariat@met.police.uk.
